channel.title: HARU TRIP - Korea Day Trip Guide
channel.description: Day trip guides to Korea with curated A, B and C courses. Discover the best spots and itineraries in Busan, Mokpo, Gangneung, Jeonju and Jeju.

item.title: HARU TRIP Mokpo | A Day Trip Guide to Mokpo, the Romantic Historic Port City
item.description: Mokpo day trip in 3 courses: the modern history street, marine cable car, local delicacies and Mokpo Bridge at night.

item.title: [Mokpo] Mokpo Modern History Hall No.1 (Former Japanese Consulate)
item.description: A national historic site in Renaissance style completed in 1900, famous as a filming location of the drama "Hotel del Luna" and a symbol of Mokpo's modern history.

item.title: [Mokpo] Seosandong Poetry & Mural Alley and Yeonhee's Supermarket
item.description: Mokpo's signature retro village, home to Yeonhee's Supermarket from the film "1987" and old alleys decorated with warm poems and murals.

item.title: [Mokpo] Yudalsan Park & Nojeokbong Peak
item.description: Mokpo's sacred mountain, where you can see Nojeokbong — tied to Admiral Yi Sun-sin's clever strategy — and a panorama of the islands of the archipelago.

item.title: [Mokpo] Mokpo Marine Cable Car (Bukhang–Yudalsan–Gohado)
item.description: 3.23 km long and up to 155 m high! A spectacular ride across mountain, sea and island with breathtaking views of the archipelago from above.

item.title: [Mokpo] Gohado Coastal Deck Trail & Panokseon Observatory
item.description: A healing coastal walk between rugged cliffs and waves, with a unique observatory shaped like Joseon warships and the scenic Dragon Head coast.

item.title: [Mokpo] Peace Square & Dancing Sea Fountain
item.description: Mokpo's favorite place to relax, with a huge floating musical fountain show, a breezy seaside promenade and plenty of ocean-view cafés.

item.title: [Mokpo] Mokpo Dongbu Market & the 9 Delicacies of Mokpo
item.description: The essence of Mokpo, the "City of Taste": sweet-and-spicy crab bibimbap, energizing chopped octopus, croaker sashimi and more of the 9 local delicacies.

item.title: [Mokpo] Mokpo Marine Skywalk
item.description: Walk 15 m above the water for a thrilling close-up view of Mokpo's harbor and the grand Mokpo Bridge — like walking on the sea.

item.title: [Mokpo] Daebandong Yudal Resort & Mokpo Bridge Night View
item.description: The perfect finale to a Mokpo day trip: watch the archipelago sunset and the illuminated Mokpo Bridge from beach cafés and cozy food stalls.

item.title: HARU TRIP Busan | A Day Trip Guide to Busan's Blue Waves and Shining Skyline
item.description: Busan day trip in 3 courses: Blueline Park, Huinnyeoul Village, Gamcheon Culture Village and Gwangan Bridge at night.

item.title: [Busan] Haeundae Blueline Park & Sky Capsule
item.description: Busan's star attraction: a disused coastal railway reborn as a seaside beach train and the elevated Sky Capsule along stunning coastal scenery.

item.title: [Busan] Cheongsapo Daritdol Skywalk & Coast
item.description: A relaxing spot where a skywalk stretches out over the sea 20 m above the water, with views of Cheongsapo's clear sea and coastline.

item.title: [Busan] Haeundae Beach & Dongbaekseom Island (Nurimaru)
item.description: Korea's most famous beach and the Dongbaekseom coastal trail, where you can see Gwangan Bridge through dense pine forest.

item.title: [Busan] Yeongdo Huinnyeoul Culture Village & Jeoryeong Coastal Tunnel
item.description: The "Santorini of Korea": walk along steep seaside cliffs at the foot of Bongnaesan, a filming location of the movie "The Attorney".

item.title: [Busan] Jagalchi Fish Market & BIFF Square Food Alley
item.description: "Come, look, buy!" Feel Busan's energy with all five senses at Korea's largest fish market and the street-food alleys of the Film Street.

item.title: [Busan] Gamcheon Culture Village & Little Prince Photo Spot
item.description: Pastel houses stacked up a hillside — the "Machu Picchu of Korea"! Look out over the village and sea alongside the Little Prince.

item.title: [Busan] Gwangalli Beach & Terrace Café Street
item.description: An urban beach facing the majestic Gwangan Bridge, lined with terrace cafés and pubs — a hub of youth and romance.

item.title: [Busan] Millac the Market
item.description: A huge cultural complex at Millak Port near Gwangalli — sit on the giant ocean-view stand with a beer and snacks and soak up the vibe.

item.title: [Busan] Gwangan Bridge "Diamond" Night View & M Drone Light Show
item.description: The dazzling finale of a Busan day trip: the 7.42 km Gwangan Bridge light show and a high-tech drone show over the night sky every Saturday.

item.title: HARU TRIP Gangneung | A Day Trip Guide to Gangneung's Coffee Coast and Jeongdongjin Sunrise
item.description: Gangneung day trip in 3 courses: Anmok Coffee Street, Gyeongpo Lake, Ojukheon and the Badabuchae-gil Trail.

item.title: [Gangneung] Anmok Beach Coffee Street
item.description: The symbol of Gangneung's coffee culture, with unique cafés lined up along the beach — every one of them looks out on the East Sea.

item.title: [Gangneung] Gyeongpo Beach & Gangmun Beach
item.description: Walk the East Coast's signature Gyeongpo Beach, with its long fine sand and pine forest, and the cozy Gangmun Beach just to the south.

item.title: [Gangneung] Gyeongpo Lake & Gyeongpodae Pavilion
item.description: Gangneung's favorite walking spot: Gyeongpo Lake, a lagoon where seawater meets fresh water, and Gyeongpodae Pavilion on the hill above it.

item.title: [Gangneung] Ojukheon House
item.description: The historic birthplace of Shin Saimdang and Yulgok Yi I, named after the black-stemmed bamboo (ojuk) that grows here.

item.title: [Gangneung] Seongyojang House
item.description: A historic upper-class home from the late Joseon period, famous for Hwalraejeong, a pavilion built over a lotus pond.

item.title: [Gangneung] Gangneung Jungang Market & Wolhwa Street
item.description: An old-downtown highlight: a traditional market full of local treats like sweet fried chicken, potato pancakes and spicy noodles, next to Wolhwa Street built on a former railway.

item.title: [Gangneung] Jeongdongjin Station & Beach
item.description: Home to Jeongdongjin Station, known as the train station closest to the sea in the world, and the famous sunrise spot of Jeongdongjin Beach.

item.title: [Gangneung] Jeongdong-Simgok Badabuchae-gil Trail
item.description: A coastal trail right above the sea along the Jeongdong coastal terrace, a natural monument long closed to the public as a military zone.

item.title: [Gangneung] Jeongdongjin Sun Cruise & Coastal Views
item.description: A one-of-a-kind resort shaped like a cruise ship on a cliff above the sea, with an observatory and sculpture park overlooking Jeongdongjin.

item.title: HARU TRIP Jeju | A Day Trip Guide to Jeju's Emerald Sea and Volcanic Island
item.description: Jeju day trip in 3 courses: Aewol coastal trail, Hyeopjae Beach, Seongsan Ilchulbong and Saeyeongyo at night.

item.title: [Jeju] Aewol Handam Coastal Trail
item.description: A trail along the black basalt coast from Aewol-ri to Gwakji Beach — clear water and ocean-view cafés make it a West Jeju favorite.

item.title: [Jeju] Hyeopjae Beach
item.description: West Jeju's signature beach, where white sand, emerald water and Biyangdo island just offshore create a picture-perfect scene.

item.title: [Jeju] O'sulloc Tea Museum
item.description: A tea museum and café beside the vast Seogwang tea fields — enjoy green tea desserts and a walk through the green rows of tea.

item.title: [Jeju] Seongsan Ilchulbong Peak
item.description: A giant crater formed by an undersea volcanic eruption — a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site and Jeju's most famous sunrise spot.

item.title: [Jeju] Seopjikoji
item.description: A long cape reaching into the sea, where grassy hills, a white lighthouse and distant Seongsan Ilchulbong make a lovely East Jeju walk.

item.title: [Jeju] Woljeong-ri Beach
item.description: A popular East Jeju beach with white sand, clear jade-colored water and stylish cafés lined up along the shore.

item.title: [Jeju] Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market & Lee Jung-seop Street
item.description: Walk the street where painter Lee Jung-seop lived with his family as a Korean War refugee, then explore Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market full of Jeju food.

item.title: [Jeju] Cheonjiyeon Waterfall
item.description: A waterfall whose name means "pond where heaven and earth meet" — walk a lush forest path to find its refreshing cascade.

item.title: [Jeju] Saeyeongyo Bridge & Saeseom Island
item.description: A pedestrian bridge linking Seogwipo Harbor and the small island of Saeseom, shaped like a traditional Jeju raft and beautifully lit at night.

item.title: HARU TRIP Jeonju | A Day Trip Guide to Jeonju, the City of Hanok and Food
item.description: Jeonju day trip in 3 courses: Hanok Village, Gyeonggijeon, Jeondong Cathedral, Nambu Market and night views.

item.title: [Jeonju] Gyeonggijeon Shrine
item.description: The shrine housing the royal portrait of King Taejo, founder of Joseon — a historic site in the heart of Jeonju Hanok Village.

item.title: [Jeonju] Jeondong Catholic Cathedral
item.description: A Romanesque cathedral built on the site of Korea's first Catholic martyrdom, one of the oldest Western-style buildings in the Honam region.

item.title: [Jeonju] Omokdae Pavilion & Jaman Mural Village
item.description: Visit Omokdae, the hilltop pavilion where Yi Seong-gye held a victory feast, and the colorful Jaman Mural Village across the footbridge.

item.title: [Jeonju] Jeonju Hyanggyo Confucian School
item.description: A Joseon-era regional school where centuries-old ginkgo trees turn the courtyard golden every autumn — a hidden gem of Jeonju.

item.title: [Jeonju] Pungnammun Gate & Nambu Market Youth Mall
item.description: The heart of a Jeonju food trip: Pungnammun, the old fortress's south gate, and Nambu Market with its bean-sprout soup alley, Youth Mall and weekend night market.

item.title: [Jeonju] Jeonju Gaeksa & Gaekridan-gil
item.description: Explore Gaeksa, the Joseon-era guesthouse for officials, and Gaekridan-gil, the surrounding lanes packed with stylish cafés and restaurants.

item.title: [Jeonju] Deokjin Park
item.description: Jeonju's signature park, famous for lotus flowers that fill a wide lake — stroll across the bridge and visit the hanok library on the water.

item.title: [Jeonju] Namcheongyo Bridge, Cheongyeonru Pavilion & Jeonjucheon
item.description: A bridge over Jeonjucheon at the south end of Hanok Village, where you can sit in the hanok pavilion Cheongyeonru and enjoy the cool breeze.

item.title: [Jeonju] Jeonju Hanok Village Alley Walk
item.description: Korea's largest urban hanok village with about 700 traditional houses, where every alley is full of cafés, workshops and street snacks.
